featured_reviews.name: Nitika Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Provenance opens its doors at Ligne Roset Prabhadevi near JK Banquet Century Bazar.
Cute boutique cafe serving delicious assorted sweet & savoury croissants & a variety of baked goodies including tea time cakes , eclairs , munchies & more along with a meticulously planned tea & coffee menu .

The piping hot chocolate topped with marshmallows  is simply sinfully delectable in all respects & should not be missed !

We tried the mushroom cheese , chilli chocolate , spinach bake , orange fondant tea cake , strawberry white chocolate eclair & cold coffee !

Every single item was busting with flavours & was baked to perfection being a delight to the taste buds .

A treasure house of luxury gourmet gifting - this is your one stop shop for the most exclusive premium quality imported chocolates , nut butters , honey , sauces , candies , teas & more .
The hampers can be curated as per your budget .

Ideal place for meetings & dates - the place is peaceful , calm & the overall vibes are cheerful & positive .
The service is flawless .
VFM for sure .
Do visit for sweet indulgence .

featured_reviews.name: Pouruchisty Elavia
featured_reviews.review_text:

The gourmet gifting options are truly unique.
